71879-the-tarzan-twins.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Why then did they look so much alike and why did everyone call them the Tarzan Twins? One could almost start a guessing contest with a conundrum like this, but the trouble is that no one would guess the correct solution, though the answer is quite simple. Dick's mother and Doc's mother were sisters--twin sisters--and they looked so much alike that they looked _more_ alike than two peas, and as each boy resembled his mother--the result was--they resembled each other.

arxiv-2205-03052.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, we study the delayed stochastic recursive optimal control problem with a non-Lipschitz generator, in which both the dynamics of the control system and the recursive cost functional depend on the past path segment of the state process in a general form. arxiv-2310-16026.title: Retrievals of Protoplanetary Disk Parameters using Thermochemical Models: I. Disk Gas Mass from Hydrogen Deuteride Spectroscopy Journal: ApJ ProDiMo ( Woitke et al. 2009 ; Kamp et al. 2010 ) , scitkit-learn ( Pedregosa et al. 2011 ) , Miex ( Wolf & Voshchinnikov 2018 )
arxiv-2310-16026.creator: Young Min Seo, Karen Willacy, Geoffrey Bryden, Dariusz C. Lis, Paul F. Goldsmith, Klaus M. Pontoppidan, Wing-Fai Thi
arxiv-2310-16026.description: Abstract We discuss statistical relationships between the mass of protoplanetary disks, the hydrogen deuteride (HD) line flux, and the dust spectral energy distribution (SED) determined using 3000 ProDiMo disk models. The models have 15 free parameters describing the disk physical properties, the central star, and the local radiation field.

arxiv-2411-00773.title: LogiCity: Advancing Neuro-Symbolic AI with Abstract Urban Simulation
arxiv-2411-00773.creator: Bowen Li, Zhaoyu Li, Qiwei Du, Jinqi Luo, Wenshan Wang, Yaqi Xie, Simon Stepputtis, Chen Wang, Katia Sycara, Pradeep Ravikumar, Alexander Gray, Xujie Si, Sebastian Scherer
arxiv-2411-00773.description: Abstract Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI systems, which integrate symbolic reasoning into deep neural networks. However, most of the existing benchmarks for NeSy AI fail to provide long-horizon reasoning tasks with complex multi-agent interactions. Furthermore, they are usually constrained by fixed and simplistic logical rules over limited entities, making them far from real-world complexities.

arxiv-2508-01896.title: Clustering of Primordial Black Holes in Excursion Set Theory
arxiv-2508-01896.creator: Encieh Erfani
arxiv-2508-01896.description: Abstract We investigate the clustering of Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) within the framework of Excursion Set Theory (EST). The EST formalism is extended to compute the joint probability of forming PBH pairs within a clustering distance, based on two stochastic trajectories with a shared history.

arxiv-2601-06572.title: Hellinger Multimodal Variational Autoencoders
arxiv-2601-06572.creator: Huyen Khanh Vo, Isabel Valera
arxiv-2601-06572.description: Abstract Multimodal variational autoencoders (VAEs) are widely used for weakly supervised generative learning with multiple modalities. Predominant methods aggregate unimodal inference distributions using either a product of experts (PoE), a mixture of experts (MoE), or their combinations to approximate the joint posterior. In this work, we revisit multimodal inference through the lens of probabilistic opinion pooling, an optimization-based approach.

pmc-10682432.description: BackgroundPediatric liver transplantation is an important modality for treating biliary atresia. pmc-11360830.title: EAIA: An Efficient and Anonymous Identity-Authentication Scheme in 5G-V2V
pmc-11360830.creator: Qianmin Du, Jianhong Zhou, Maode Ma, Omprakash Kaiwartya
pmc-11360830.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Vehicle Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) have experienced significant development in recent years, playing a crucial role in enhancing the driving experience by enabling safer and more efficient inter-vehicle interactions through information exchange. Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication is particularly vital as it not only helps to prevent collisions and improve traffic efficiency but also provides essential situational awareness to drivers or autonomous driving systems.

pmc-11505312.title: Diseased Tendon Models Demonstrate Influence of Extracellular Matrix Alterations on Extracellular Vesicle Profile
pmc-11505312.creator: Kariman A. Shama, Zachary Franklin Greenberg, Chadine Tammame, Mei He, Brittany L. Taylor
pmc-11505312.description: Tendons enable movement through their highly aligned extracellular matrix (ECM), predominantly composed of collagen I. Tendinopathies disrupt the structural integrity of tendons by causing fragmentation of collagen fibers, disorganization of fiber bundles, and an increase in glycosaminoglycans and microvasculature, thereby driving the apparent biomechanical and regenerative capacity in patients.

pmc-11585510.creator: Macarena Artigas-Arias, Andrea Alegría-Molina, Nicolás Vidal-Seguel, Rodrigo Muñoz-Cofre, Juan Carranza-Leiva, Alexis Sepúlveda-Lara, Kaio Fernando Vitzel, Nolberto Huard, Jorge Sapunar, Luis A. Salazar, Rui Curi, Gabriel Nasri Marzuca-Nassr

However, its effects on these parameters in postmenopausal breast cancer survivors are controversial or limited. pmc-11603650.title: Searching for the ‘X’ factor: investigating the genetics of primary ovarian insufficiency
pmc-11603650.creator: Anya Knight, Sara Sugin, Andrea Jurisicova
pmc-11603650.description: Primary ovarian insufficiency (POI) is the cessation of ovarian function before the age of 40. The causes of POI are heterogeneous, but substantial evidence exists to support a genetic basis of POI, particularly in the critical involvement of genes on the X chromosome. Recent studies have revealed novel candidate genes through the identification of copy number variations associated with POI.

pmc-11629302.title: Influence of nickel hydroxide catalyst ink formulation on direct bar coating of anion exchange membranes†
pmc-11629302.creator: Mohamed Elshamy, Lukas Metzler, Joey Disch, Severin Vierrath, Susanne Koch
pmc-11629302.description: Achieving uniform and high-performing catalyst-coated membranes (CCMs) is a critical challenge in the field of electrochemical energy conversion technologies. This challenge is particularly pronounced in the coating of catalyst inks, where optimizing ink formulations and mixing conditions is essential for producing homogeneous catalyst layers that enhance electrochemical performance.

pmc-12597288.title: The safety and efficacy of extended use of an oral shape-shifting superabsorbent hydrogel capsule for weight loss: The ELECT extension study

pmc-12715990.title: Novel Insights Into the Bioactive Profile and Therapeutic Potentials of Indonesian Annona muricata Leaves
pmc-12715990.creator: Sara Oufquir, Fatimazahra Agouram, Hamid Kabdy, Mehdi Ait Laaradia, Khadija Oubella, Baslam Abdelmoniim, Aboufatima Rachida, Stefania Garzoli, Abderrahman Chait
pmc-12715990.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study investigates, for the first time, the comprehensive pharmacological profile of the aqueous extract of Annona muricata L. (graviola) leaves from Indonesia, focusing on its antioxidant, antinociceptive, and anti‐inflammatory properties, alongside its acute toxicity and phytochemical composition. The extract, obtained through cold maceration, was rich in phenolic compounds, including gallic acid, catechin, quercetin, and rutin, as revealed by phytochemical analysis. It exhibited strong antioxidant capacity in both 2,2‐diphenyl‐1‐picrylhydrazyl (DPPH) and ferric‐reducing antioxidant power (FRAP) assays.

pmc-12871041.title: Cobalt-based metallo-mesoionic carbene gold complexes with antiproliferative effects
pmc-12871041.creator: D. Menia, F. R. Neururer, K. Wurst, P. Lippmann, I. V. Esarev, M. Seidl, I. Ott, M. Podewitz, S. Hohloch, B. Bildstein
pmc-12871041.description: We report the facile synthesis of new gold(i) carbene complexes based on a mesoionic cobaltocenylidene metallocarbene via a fluorinative desilylation reaction. The carbene has been characterized by a variety of spectroscopic methods, revealing that it has the highest HEP value reported for a MIC so far, suggesting that the carbene is highly electron donating.

pmc-13358282.creator: Robabe Seyedi, Mojgan Mirghafourvand, Jafar Tanha, Hamid Alavi Majd, Fatemeh Nahidi
pmc-13358282.description: IntroductionPolycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a prevalent endocrine condition in reproductive-aged women, which is associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in pregnancy. In the present study, pregnancy complications—like gestational diabetes, preterm birth, hypertension, low birth weight and neonatal intensive care unit admission—will be predicted with high accuracy by machine learning-based prediction models.

pmc-13420558.title: Idiopathic 2:1 AV Block With Ventriculophasic Sinus Arrhythmia in a Young Male
pmc-13420558.creator: Christopher Tortorici, Gustavo Duarte, Justin D. Mark, Roshan Wardak, Jose Muniz, Elias Collado
pmc-13420558.description: BackgroundSecond-degree atrioventricular (AV) block in young adults is rare and typically associated with structural, infectious, or genetic etiologies. Ventriculophasic sinus arrhythmia is classically associated with complete heart block and is rarely described in isolated 2:1 AV block.Case SummaryA 23-year-old male with no prior medical history presented to the clinic with influenza-like symptoms and was incidentally found to have marked bradycardia.

pmc-13530862.title: Prefrontal Neurovascular Coupling Abnormalities Associated With Cognitive Performance in Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-13530862.creator: Ruisi Gong, Hao Zhang, Jinlin Jiao, Lei Liu, Xiaohan Xu, Huiwen Song, Yuexin Zhou, Yuanjie Duan, Hefei Fu, Jibin Cao, Lingling Cui
pmc-13530862.description: BackgroundCognitive impairment is a prevalent and debilitating feature in multiple sclerosis (MS), yet its pathophysiology remains incompletely understood. Dysfunction of the neurovascular unit (NVU) and impaired neurovascular coupling (NVC) may be related to cognitive performance in MS, but this pathway remains insufficiently studied. This study investigated whether NVC abnormalities are associated with cognitive performance in MS.
